messages:
lina: Opening PR to refresh the HelloLaunchpad quickstart. Goal: modernize onboarding, prefer token env var auth (REDWOOD_API_KEY), add a tiny Go example, and replace legacy docker run steps with a local-compose dev flow. PR: #4620. Looking for review on wording and the migration blurb.
mike: LGTM on the token move. Can you paste the Go snippet and the devcontainer hint so I can sanity-check?
arjun: Also please add a short non-alarming migration note for anyone who followed cookie/session examples before.
lina: Sure — snippets below (kept intentionally minimal so folks get immediate feedback):

```bash
# .env
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_LAUNCHPAD
```

```go
// main.go (Go)
package main

import (
  "context"
  "fmt"
  "os"

  "github.com/redwood/sdk-go"
)

func main() {
  apiKey := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
  client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithAPIKey(apiKey))
  resp, _ := client.Chat.Create(context.Background(), redwood.ChatRequest{Model: "redwood-mini", Input: "Hello from Go quickstart"})
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```

lina: Devcontainer hint (Codespaces/VSCode): add this to devcontainer.json: "\"runArgs\": [\"-e\", \"REDWOOD_API_KEY=${localEnv:REDWOOD_API_KEY}\"]". And run locally command: `docker compose up --build hello-launchpad`.
mike: Nice. For migration blurb, maybe: "If you previously used SESSION_TOKEN in examples, set REDWOOD_API_KEY instead; server-side cookie auth remains supported for Dedicated/Private customers (see enterprise auth docs)." Keep it short and link to /enterprise/auth.
arjun: Also add one line about SDK migration: quick note that examples use SDK v3+; add a link to the SDK migration guide for teams on older SDKs.
lina: Added both. I also swapped the model examples to `redwood-mini` by default so the quickstart stays cheap and fast. Updated PR description and enabled a link-check CI job.
pepper-bot: CI: lint: passed, link-check: passed, preview: https://deploy-preview-4620--docs.redwood.ai
ci-check: Status: preview site built. Smoke task queued for staging after merge.
mike: Left two tiny copy nits inline. Otherwise LGTM. Approving after those fixes.
arjun: Approved. :thumbsup:
lina: Thanks both! Merged. I'll follow up with a small CI smoke that runs the quickstart container and then backfill a short example into the migration guide for SESSION_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY.
pepper-bot: Auto-merge completed. (PR #4620 merged)
